verdict.rationale: ROS 2 ships its own data recording (`ros2 bag` record/play) and documents a Python API for reading from and writing to bags in your own code, so collected robot data can be retrieved programmatically for offline analysis. Community users also credit ROS with built-in data bagging and recordable messages. However, the evidence shows only raw read access, with no documented query or filtering capability, SQL interface, or export to analysis formats. missing for 10: query/filter semantics over recorded data, SQL access, documented export to analysis formats (e.g. CSV/Parquet), independent hands-on corroboration of offline-analysis workflows.
